candidates: When restructuring the README hero/header section (e.g., adding a centered logo and title), adopt a deliberate and consistent strategy for badge placement: either include all status/CI badges within the centered HTML header block, or keep only a minimal selection there (e.g., just the version badge) with the rest in a plain Markdown block below. Avoid splitting badges across the header and body without an explicit reason.

When reorganizing README sections, ensure that quick-access navigation links (e.g., CDN, documentation, contribution guide) remain visible and prominent — ideally in the header/hero section — rather than being silently removed. If such links are relocated from their current position in the body, they should reappear somewhere equally discoverable.

Before including links to project files (such as changelogs, migration guides, or other docs) in prominent README sections, verify that the target files are actively maintained and up to date. Remove or replace links to files known to be stale or abandoned to avoid misleading users.
